# `admin` operations

The exact fields each `admin.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; for an HTTP call with no token on a single-user server, the install's org on every op but `code.*` and `tracker.*` (which keep their plane's), and on [some ops](../http-api.md#request) its namespace and agent; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `admin.users`

Aggregate subjects from namespace_grants + namespaces.owner_email, join in last-active from the audit log, mark configured platform admins.

`POST /v1/admin.users` · MCP `loom_admin_users` · role `org_admin` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str \| None` | `None` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `include_service_accounts` | `bool` | `False` | Also list subjects with neither a contact email nor a password (service accounts); off, they are left out. |
| `limit` | `int` | `200` | At most this many users, in subject order; 1 to 1,000. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `users` | `list[UserSummary]` | The page of users in subject order, each with its grants and owned namespaces. |
| `total` | `int` | Users matching the filters before `limit` was applied. |
| `total_pending_elevations` | `int` | Grants on this page with an unapproved elevation request. |
| `total_active_last_7d` | `int` | Users on this page with an audit row in the last 7 days. |
| `platform_admins_configured` | `list[str]` | The configured platform-admin identities, sorted; empty unless the caller is a platform admin (or auth is off). |

<!-- prettier-ignore-end -->
